purpose: The preferences panel of a collection, after Cloudscape's collection preferences: a cog button opens a dialog (or a drawer) with the page size, the columns (shown, hidden and ordered; a locked column always shows), wrapped lines, striped rows and density. Changes are a draft until Confirm; Cancel, `Esc` and the close button discard them. It holds no saved state itself: `useCollection` saves the confirmed value in `localStorage` and `preferencesProps` binds the value, the columns and the page sizes in one `v-bind`. It is the one column chooser of a table. Placed in a DataTable's `toolbar` slot with no `columns`, it reads the table through context: the columns are the table's hideable leaf columns (a column with `hideable: false` is listed locked), the draft starts from the table's column visibility and order, and Confirm writes both back to the table (`update:columnVisibility`) besides emitting `confirm` and `update:preferences`. Bound to `useCollection`, `preferencesProps` supplies `columns` and the context is not read.
useWhen: Use CollectionPreferences for every 'how this list looks' setting: page size, visible and ordered columns, density, wrap.
A table or card collection whose people choose how many items a page shows and which fields they see.
Any collection driven by `useCollection`, which saves the result per collection.
avoidWhen: Settings of the resource itself (not of how the list shows it) → use a form page or `dialog`.
related: use-collection` — saves the preferences; `preferencesProps` is the binding.
data-table` — takes `density`, `wrapLines`, `striped`, the visible columns and their order; inside its toolbar this panel edits its columns with no wiring.
card-list` — takes the page size and the visible fields.
property-filter` — sits beside it in the controls row.
bestPractices: Lock the column that names the item (`locked: true`): a row without its name is unreadable.
Show only the sections the collection uses (`sections`): cards have no striped rows.
Keep the trigger at the end of the controls row, after Refresh and Download.
